metadata.datasource: Measured off Fujifilm data sheet AF3-608E, NEOPAN 1600 Super Presto / Professional, 35 mm, D-76 developer, small tank, 7 1/2 min at 20 C (Fujifilm's time for EI 1600). Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with mid-grey where a meter set to EI 1600 puts it on the sheet's absolute axis (log H -2.294); the curve's own ISO speed point is ISO 721; base + fog 0.185. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: Fujifilm's spectrogram to daylight (5400K), divided by CIE daylight at 5400 K (read as it stands it implies a 6.6x red filter factor, against Fujifilm's 8x). One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
